sentences.en: You must concentrate your attention on what you are doing.
sentences.zh: 你必须全神贯注于你在做的事情。

sentences.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
sentences.zh: 因为有噪音，我无法集中精力工作。

sentences.en: I concentrated my attention on the little things of history.
sentences.zh: 我把注意力集中在历史上的琐事上。

senses.zh: 集中；浓缩；全神贯注；聚集
